text:
Nora: hi folks, day 1 and i'm stuck on a few things: Okta says "No app assigned" for Google Workspace, 1Password invite link expired, and trying to enroll a passkey with my YubiKey on Fedora gives "Authenticator not allowed". any quick pointers?
Priya (IT): welcome! can you confirm which email the invites went to (work vs personal)? i can reassign apps and resend 1P. also try disabling any VPN and use Chrome for passkey enrollment on linux.
Nora: invite was to nora.personal+redwood@gmail.com, not my work email (nora@redwood.ai). oops. i'm on the corporate VPN right now as well.
devops: VPN can interfere with WebAuthn origins. if you can, drop the VPN and try again. also check `lsusb` or `gpg --card-status` to validate the YubiKey is seen.
Nora: dropped VPN, ran lsusb: "Bus 002 Device 007: ID 1050:0407 Yubico.com Yubikey 5". switched to Chrome and used the Okta org URL, still got NotAllowedError in console.
Priya (IT): i resent 1Password to nora@redwood.ai and mapped the personal alias so you'll get apps. check your inbox. toggled the org-level WebAuthn setting off/on as a quick fix — can you retry enrolling?
onboarding-bot: 1Password invite resent to nora@redwood.ai at 1873456812.
Nora: retried and passkey enrollment worked! yubikey registered as "nora-yubikey1". 1Password invite accepted too. thanks for the help y'all.
Priya (IT): great — i pushed a manual directory sync so Google Workspace should be available. ping if anything else acts up.
Nora: confirmed google drive + slack access. ssh pubkey imported via 1Password, can ssh into dev box. thanks everyone! :tada:
